answer: Anchor every identity to one machine's timing signature: at a random hour a lantern signal goes out and each identity must answer a latency-bound challenge from a peer within seconds, proving a live, distinct network position. One server cannot fake a gale of instant replies from a thousand addresses, since each reply needs its own connection and clock. A swarm sharing one rig trips the same timing fingerprint twice and forfeits its bond, while honest agents answer from where they already live.
